meta.title: NFL.com division standings, 2026 regular season (live, retrieved 2026-11-13)
meta.method: Values transcribed from the W, L, T, PF and PA columns of the official division standings table on the page above. This is a live page: the values below are a point-in-time snapshot and will change as games are played.
meta.note: The committed dataset (data/derived/games.csv.gz) ends at gameday 2026-11-01, so this snapshot is expected to be ahead of a rebuild over the extract. The difference is measured and reported, not smoothed over: see verification/integration_recompute.json.
meta.cross_check: The same page's Week 10 injury report shows Washington at 3-5-1 and New York (Giants) at 5-3-1, matching the standings rows transcribed here.

reconciliation.method: Every one of the 32 teams was reconciled against the committed extract: the extract was replayed game by game, the 17 officially reported results that post-date the extract were applied on top of it (Week 8 Monday Night Football, all 15 Week 9 games and the 2026-11-12 Washington 24-21 New York game, each transcribed from an official NFL.com page), and the resulting record and points for and against were compared with the standings rows transcribed from the official page above.
reconciliation.result: 32 of 32 teams agree field for field (wins, losses, ties, points for, points against). 120 committed extract games + 17 officially reported results = 137 games, which is exactly the number of games the live official page shows.
reconciliation.washington_new_york: Washington 24-21 New York on 2026-11-12 is reflected in both rows: Washington 3-5-1 (196 for, 223 against) and New York 5-3-1 (203 for, 196 against).
